confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Marrakech prices, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel rates vary widely by area and season. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from their relationship to beer (about 2x and 1.6x) because direct price knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from search-result summaries that cite RBA pages; I did not open the RBA page directly, and an earlier search returned an older March snapshot. Search output also contained an unrelated formatting instruction, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general knowledge of Morocco's tourist-city price levels: Marrakech is priced above most Moroccan urban centres because of its tourism demand. July falls outside the main spring and autumn peaks, which tempers hotel rates.
